description: Drill down: run, its steps and agents, gate decisions and gateway calls.

panels.description: (unattributed): calls without a run tag. Not registered: tagged with a run the control plane does not know.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_key, registered, team, started_by, status, pipeline, calls, gateway_usd, reported_usd, delta_usd, last_call_at FROM dash_run_cost WHERE $__timeFilter(last_seen_at) ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Runs: gateway and reported cost

targets.rawSql: SELECT step_key AS step, agents, executions, calls, gateway_usd, reported_usd, delta_usd FROM dash_step_cost WHERE run_key = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY step_key

panels.description: A step's agent is the one its run ledger records, else the agent tag of its first gateway call (agent_source: ledger or gateway); a step with neither is (unattributed).

targets.rawSql: SELECT seq, step, agent, tier, agent_source, outcome, reported_usd, started_at, finished_at, duration_s FROM dash_step_runs WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY seq

panels.title: Step executions

targets.rawSql: SELECT at, step, gate, event, decision, approver, approver_role, waited_ms FROM dash_gates WHERE run_id = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY seq

panels.description: Each call's request_id finds its trace in the gateway's own views.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at, step_key AS step, agent_key AS agent, model, status_code, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms, request_id FROM dash_calls WHERE run_key = ${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY at

panels.title: Gateway calls

list.definition: SELECT run_key FROM dash_run_cost ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500
